gui.config.title: Immersive Vehicles Settings
gui.config.controls.title: Choose a control category:
gui.config.server.remote_read_only: Remote server settings cannot be viewed or changed here; the values below are local defaults.
gui.config.server.advanced_json: These advanced settings can only be edited in the server config JSON.
gui.config.control_scheme.label: Control Mode
gui.config.control_scheme.tooltip: Choose how aircraft are controlled: manual keys, mouse yoke, or arcade mouse steering.
gui.config.joystick.error: Immersive Vehicles could not initialize joystick controls. Check the controller connection and drivers, then reopen this screen to scan again.
gui.config.joystick.disabled: Joystick initialization stalled or failed. Joystick support is disabled for this session. Check device drivers and restart the game.
gui.config.joystick.name: Name:
gui.config.joystick.choosemap: Choose a control to map to this input.
gui.config.joystick.calibrate1: Move the axis through its full range.
gui.config.joystick.calibrate2: Select Confirm to save the calibration.
gui.config.rendering.label: Select the rendering pipeline. Slower modes improve compatibility with shaders and performance mods, but reduce FPS.
gui.config.option.renderHUD_1P.label: First-person HUD
gui.config.option.renderHUD_1P.tooltip: Show the vehicle HUD in first-person view.
gui.config.option.renderHUD_3P.label: Third-person HUD
gui.config.option.renderHUD_3P.tooltip: Show the vehicle HUD in third-person view.
gui.config.option.fullHUD_1P.label: Full-size first-person HUD
gui.config.option.fullHUD_1P.tooltip: Use the full-size HUD instead of the compact HUD in first-person view.
gui.config.option.fullHUD_3P.label: Full-size third-person HUD
gui.config.option.fullHUD_3P.tooltip: Use the full-size HUD instead of the compact HUD in third-person view.
gui.config.option.transpHUD_1P.label: Transparent first-person HUD
gui.config.option.transpHUD_1P.tooltip: Hide HUD background textures in first-person view.
gui.config.option.transpHUD_3P.label: Transparent third-person HUD
gui.config.option.transpHUD_3P.tooltip: Hide HUD background textures in third-person view.
gui.config.option.renderWindows.label: Render windows
gui.config.option.innerWindows.label: Render windows from inside
gui.config.option.innerWindows.tooltip: Render vehicle windows from the inside. Has no effect when Render windows is disabled.
gui.config.option.freecam_3P.label: Independent third-person camera
gui.config.option.freecam_3P.tooltip: Make third-person camera rotation independent of vehicle rotation and follow only the rider's view.
gui.config.option.renderFlares.label: Render light flares
gui.config.option.renderBeams.label: Render light beams
gui.config.option.brightLights.label: Full-bright lights
gui.config.option.brightLights.tooltip: Render vehicle and block lights at full brightness. Disable if this causes shader issues.
gui.config.option.blendedLights.label: Blend light beams
gui.config.option.blendedLights.tooltip: Use blending to brighten the world beneath light beams.
gui.config.option.lightsTransp.label: Translucent lit textures
gui.config.option.lightsTransp.tooltip: Render emissive textures in the translucent pass. Required by some shaders, but may cause issues without shaders.
gui.config.option.playerTweaks.label: Player model adjustments
gui.config.option.playerTweaks.tooltip: Adjust the player's hands while holding guns and limbs while riding vehicles. Disable and restart if another mod causes model issues.
gui.config.option.renderingMode.label: Rendering mode
gui.config.option.renderingMode.tooltip: Select the rendering pipeline. Slower modes improve compatibility with shaders and performance mods, but reduce FPS.
gui.config.option.kbOverride.label: Joystick overrides keyboard
gui.config.option.kbOverride.tooltip: Ignore a keyboard control while its joystick equivalent is mapped. Enable to free those keys while using a joystick.
gui.config.option.north360.label: North at 360°
gui.config.option.north360.tooltip: Show north as 360° on instruments instead of Minecraft's 180° heading.
gui.config.option.simpleThrottle.label: Simplified driving controls
gui.config.option.simpleThrottle.tooltip: Gas and brake also select forward or reverse while stopped, brakes hold automatically at low speed, and transmissions shift automatically.
gui.config.option.halfThrottle.label: Half throttle by default
gui.config.option.halfThrottle.tooltip: Make Gas apply half throttle and Modifier + Gas apply full throttle. Only affects car/boat on-off throttles and is incompatible with simplified controls.
gui.config.option.autostartEng.label: Automatic engine start
gui.config.option.autostartEng.tooltip: Start engines when the driver enters, stop them and apply the parking brake when the driver leaves. Fuel and electrical requirements still apply.
gui.config.option.autoTrnSignals.label: Automatic turn signals
gui.config.option.autoTrnSignals.tooltip: Activate turn signals when a turn begins and cancel them when it ends. When disabled, use key bindings or the control panel.
gui.config.option.useShifter.label: Physical gear shifter
gui.config.option.useShifter.tooltip: Enable when using a physical H-pattern shifter so neutral is detected when no gear button is pressed.
gui.config.option.heliAutoLevel.label: Helicopter auto-level
gui.config.option.heliAutoLevel.tooltip: Return helicopters to level flight when the controls are released. This makes flying easier but prevents loops.
gui.config.option.mouseYoke.label: Mouse yoke
gui.config.option.mouseYoke.tooltip: Control aircraft pitch and roll with an invisible mouse yoke. Screen center is neutral; edges are full input.
gui.config.option.arcadeMode.label: Arcade mode
gui.config.option.arcadeMode.tooltip: Enable arcade flight and aiming: the mouse steers aircraft and helicopters and a gun-aiming crosshair is shown.
gui.config.option.showAimHelper.label: Aim helper
gui.config.option.showAimHelper.tooltip: Show a crosshair at the active weapon's predicted impact point in Arcade control mode.
gui.config.option.showTutorial.label: Show tutorials
gui.config.option.showHoverTxt.label: Show hover hints
gui.config.option.showHoverTxt.tooltip: Show helper text while looking at supported vehicle elements.
gui.config.option.cullingWarn.label: Entity Culling warning
gui.config.option.cullingWarn.tooltip: Show a one-time startup warning when Entity Culling is detected.
gui.config.option.classicJystk.label: Classic joystick input
gui.config.option.classicJystk.tooltip: Use the legacy controller backend. It may crash mobile devices and alter bindings. Enable only for unrecognized controllers, then restart the game.
gui.config.option.steeringControlRate.to: Degrees per tick that vehicle wheels turn while a steering key is held. Not used with a joystick.
gui.config.option.steeringReturnRate.too: Degrees per tick that vehicle wheels return while no steering key is held. Not used with a joystick.
gui.config.option.flightControlRate.tool: Degrees per tick that elevators and ailerons move while a control key is held. Not used with a joystick.
gui.config.option.mouseYokeRate.label: Mouse-yoke sensitivity
gui.config.option.mouseYokeRate.tooltip: Degrees of control-surface movement per mouse input unit when using the Mouse control scheme.
gui.config.option.DismountSafteySpeed.to: Vehicle speed in m/s above which dismounting requires pressing Shift twice within 3 seconds. Set to 0 to always require confirmation, or very high for instant dismounting.
gui.config.option.joystickDeadZone.label: Joystick dead zone
gui.config.option.joystickDeadZone.toolt: Dead zone for joystick axes. Applies to every joystick.
gui.config.option.soundVolume.label: Sound volume
gui.config.option.soundVolume.tooltip: Volume of all Immersive Vehicles sounds, independent of Minecraft's master volume.
gui.config.option.radioVolume.label: Radio volume
gui.config.option.radioVolume.tooltip: Volume of Immersive Vehicles radios, independent of Minecraft's master volume.
gui.config.option.generateOverrideConfig: At startup, export crafting and damage overrides plus language templates to the config folder. Existing override files are overwritten; language templates must be added to packs to take effect.
gui.config.option.opSignEditingOnly.tool: On servers, allow only operators to edit signs. Singleplayer worlds are unaffected.
gui.config.option.opPickupVehiclesOnly.t: On servers, allow only operators to pick up vehicles with wrenches. Singleplayer worlds are unaffected.
gui.config.option.creativePickupVehicles: Allow vehicles to be picked up only by players in Creative mode.
gui.config.option.keyRequiredToStartVehi: Require the player to hold the vehicle's key before starting it.
gui.config.option.noclipVehicles.label: Disable vehicle block collisions
gui.config.option.noclipVehicles.tooltip: Prevent vehicles from colliding with blocks. Vehicles without wheels cannot move, which keeps them from falling through the terrain.
gui.config.option.chunkloadVehicles.tool: Keep vehicles on roads or tracks loaded so they can continue into otherwise unloaded chunks.
gui.config.option.doLegacyLightCompats.t: Apply compatibility fixes to older pack lights during startup. This can significantly increase load time; restart to apply changes.
gui.config.option.useHSV.label: Export colors as HSV
gui.config.option.useHSV.tooltip: Export color values from developer mode as HSV instead of hexadecimal RGB.
gui.config.option.allPlanesWithNav.label: Navigation for all aircraft
gui.config.option.allPlanesWithNav.toolt: Allow every aircraft to use navigation beacons, including aircraft whose packs do not enable radio navigation.
gui.config.option.giveManualsOnJoin.tool: Give each player the mod manuals and a part scanner the first time they join.
gui.config.option.performModCompatFuncti: Run compatibility integrations for other mods. Disable only when a modpack provides its own compatibility fixes.
gui.config.option.forceRenderLastSolid.t: Render Immersive Vehicles during the late world-render event. Enable only to fix invisible models caused by compatibility issues, such as ReplayMod.
gui.config.option.devMode.label: Developer mode
gui.config.option.devMode.tooltip: Enable the in-vehicle developer screen for editing pack JSON without restarting the game.
gui.config.option.roadMaxLength.label: Maximum road-segment length
gui.config.option.roadMaxLength.tooltip: Maximum length, in blocks, of one road segment. Larger values increase collision and interaction cost, and segments outside their chunk may not render. Must be a whole number.
gui.config.option.aircraftSpeedFactor.to: Multiplier applied to aircraft movement. A value of 1 is physically realistic but usually too fast for Minecraft; change with care.
gui.config.option.carSpeedFactor.label: Car and boat speed factor
gui.config.option.carSpeedFactor.tooltip: Multiplier applied to car and boat movement. A value of 1 is physically realistic but usually too fast for Minecraft; change with care.
gui.config.option.fuelUsageFactor.label: Fuel usage factor
gui.config.option.fuelUsageFactor.toolti: Global multiplier for engine fuel consumption. Lower values use less fuel; 0 disables fuel consumption and lets engines run without fuel.
gui.config.option.engineHoursFactor.tool: Multiplier for how quickly engine hours accumulate and engines wear. Higher values increase wear.
gui.config.option.climbSpeed.label: Vehicle climb rate
gui.config.option.climbSpeed.tooltip: Blocks a vehicle may rise per tick when its wheels enter terrain. Higher values climb obstacles faster but make movement less smooth.
gui.config.option.gravityFactor.label: Vehicle gravity factor
gui.config.option.gravityFactor.tooltip: Multiplier for gravity on non-aircraft vehicles. Increase it if ground vehicles feel too floaty; aircraft are unaffected.
gui.config.option.maxFlightHeight.label: Maximum flight height
gui.config.option.maxFlightHeight.toolti: Limit how high aircraft can fly. Set to 0 to let their natural physics determine the ceiling.
Multiplier for engine heating caused by RPM. Higher values make engines heat faster at high RPM.
Multiplier for ambient biome temperature in engine heat calculations. Higher values make hot biomes heat engines more.
Conversion factor from RF or FE into internal vehicle electricity.
gui.config.option.vehicleDeathDespawnTim: Seconds before a vehicle at 0 health is removed. Set to 0 to keep destroyed vehicles indefinitely.
gui.config.option.seaLevel.label: Sea level
gui.config.option.seaLevel.tooltip: Y level used as the zero point for altitude and in engine-performance calculations.
gui.config.option.defaultVehicleRepairMa: Item registry IDs used to repair vehicles that define no repair recipe in their pack JSON.
gui.config.option.defaultPartRepairMater: Item registry IDs used to repair parts that define no repair recipe in their pack JSON.
gui.config.option.engineDimensionBlackli: Dimension IDs in which engines cannot start. Ignored when the engine dimension whitelist contains entries.
gui.config.option.engineDimensionWhiteli: Dimension IDs in which engines may run. When nonempty, this list overrides the engine dimension blacklist.
gui.config.option.packVehicleScales.tool: Map pack IDs to scale multipliers applied to every vehicle in each pack. A value of 1 keeps the pack's original scale.
gui.config.option.packSpeedFactors.label: Per-pack speed factors
gui.config.option.packSpeedFactors.toolt: Map pack IDs to movement-speed multipliers. Values multiply the global aircraft or car and boat speed factor.
gui.config.option.joinedPlayers.label: Manual recipient history
gui.config.option.joinedPlayers.tooltip: Internal list of player UUIDs that have already received the starter manuals and part scanner.
gui.config.option.bulletBlockBreaking.to: Allow bullets and bombs to break blocks. Disabling also prevents explosive block damage and incendiary fire, but does not disable the explosions themselves.
gui.config.option.bulletExplosions.label: Projectile explosions
gui.config.option.bulletExplosions.toolt: Allow bullets and bombs to create explosions. Block damage remains controlled separately by Projectile block damage.
gui.config.option.vehicleBlockBreaking.t: Allow vehicles to break blocks on collision or explosion. When disabled, vehicles stop on impact and their explosions leave blocks intact.
gui.config.option.vehicleDestruction.too: Allow high-speed impacts with blocks to damage and destroy vehicles.
gui.config.option.vehicleExplosions.tool: Allow vehicles to explode when destroyed by crashes or weapons. When disabled, destroyed vehicles disappear without exploding.
gui.config.option.creativePlayerDamage.t: Allow Immersive Vehicles vehicles and weapons to damage players in Creative mode.
gui.config.option.wheelBreakage.label: Wheel breakage
gui.config.option.wheelBreakage.tooltip: Allow wheels to break and go flat.
gui.config.option.wheelDamageIgnoreVeloc: Ignore vehicle speed when calculating damage dealt by its wheels.
gui.config.option.allowExternalDamage.to: Allow vanilla damage and sources outside Immersive Vehicles, including other mods' weapons, to damage vehicles. Disable if external damage is unbalanced.
Multiplier for damage dealt by spinning propellers.
gui.config.option.jetDamageFactor.label: Jet damage factor
gui.config.option.jetDamageFactor.toolti: Multiplier for damage dealt by jet-engine intakes and exhaust.
gui.config.option.wheelDamageFactor.tool: Multiplier for damage vehicles deal to entities with their wheels.
gui.config.option.blockCrashDamageFactor: Multiplier for damage a vehicle takes when hitting blocks above its configured crash-speed threshold.
gui.config.option.crashDamageFactor.tool: Multiplier for damage dealt to occupants when their vehicle explodes in a crash.
gui.config.option.bulletDamageFactor.too: Global multiplier for damage non-heat bullets deal to vehicles. Combined with the firing pack's bullet damage factor.
gui.config.option.wheelDamageMinimumVelo: Minimum vehicle speed required before its wheels can damage entities.
gui.config.option.packBulletDamageFactor: Map pack IDs to damage multipliers for non-heat bullets from each pack. Values multiply the global bullet damage factor for vehicle and entity hits.
